Organization Owner
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - matches capella-role:organization-owner in the registry

relations.subject: capella:mfa
relations.evidence: If your organization uses federated and single sign-on authentication, your SSO users can't use Capella's MFA solution. Instead, they use your Identity Provider's MFA.

relations.subject: capella:mfa
relations.evidence: If you are an [Organization Owner](../organization-user-roles.md#organization-role-organization-owner), you can view the MFA status (_Activated_ or _Needs Activation_) for each account in your organization.

notable_absence.finding: Unlike prior-round Capella pages (e.g. audit-management.md, auditing.md) that gate features on a support plan or edition, this MFA page states no plan, edition, or licensing gate at all - MFA reads as available to every Capella account regardless of tier. This is a clean absence, not an oversight worth flagging as a docs-issue.

cross_product_finding: This page contains neither of the two recurring anomalies watched for in this round (no server-version-string citation, no Enterprise/Community edition badge) - consistent with the batch hypothesis that these are less likely on non-statement-reference management-plane pages.
